entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.117 of 2022, pending in the file of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-P.O. Special Court under POCSO Act, Baripada, arising out of Khunta P.S. Case No.0242 of 2022 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 363/365/376(2)(n)/294/323/506/313/34 IPC and Section 6(1) of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-P.O. Special Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Presiding Officer Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Mayurbhanj, Baripada by order dated 09.01.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Taking into account the tenor of allegation, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage.
5. It shall be open to the petitioner to move the learned Court in seisin after examination of the victim which shall be considered on its own merit.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
